title: Attachment
description: A file attached to a task. Attachments have a two-phase lifecycle: pending (upload slot reserved) and ready (binary confirmed). Implementations MAY expose intermediate status values but MUST support at least pending and ready. The attachment resource is additive in v0.1.4 and does not break the v0.1.0 surface.

task_id.description: The task this attachment belongs to. Attachment scope and authorization derive from the task's project.

filename.description: Original filename as provided by the uploader.

size_bytes.description: File size in bytes as declared by the uploader. Implementations SHOULD verify this matches the actual binary size during finalization.

status.description: pending: upload slot reserved, binary not yet confirmed. ready: binary confirmed, attachment is accessible via url.

url.description: Opaque download URL. null while status is pending. Set by the implementation on finalization; format is implementation-defined.

created_by.description: ID of the actor who created the upload slot.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the attachment record was created.
